projection_schema.tapping_profile_projection: One row per tapping_profile record: thread identity, tap_drill (primary), alternative_drill (ISO 2306, UNC/UNF only), engagement model (radial capability + axial not_calculable), tap_types (relationship-resolved), standards (resolved), data_quality.
projection_schema.tapping_tap_type_projection: One row per tap_type entity: taxonomy_axis, definition, application_notes split into 3 classified arrays, evidence_status counts.

tap_drill_fields.note: 9 metric tap_drill.status=verified (cross-checked against ISO 2306 Table 1 in T2.1). 20 tap_drill.status=source_bound (5 remaining metric fine-pitch + 8 UNC + 7 UNF = 20). Overall data_quality.record_status remains source_bound on all 29 rows because thread_engagement/tapping_parameters remain unavailable knowledge-layer-wide -- this is a correct, unchanged T1 convention, not a T3 regression.

iso_2306_alternative_fields.rule: Present on every UNC/UNF row (15), null on every metric row (14) -- mechanically enforced by validate-tapping-projections.js's 'ISO 2306 Alternative Structural Correctness' check.

standards_representation.resolution_method: Read directly from each tapping dataset's source_standards array, resolved against actual standard records -- not inferred from naming similarity

determinism.note: Checksum updated by the T3 correction (see audit/t3-correction.md). The original committed checksum (5397c97c...) was generated by a buggy version of the generator whose tap_drill.status output did not match this report's own stated 9/20 breakdown -- see audit/t3-correction.md for full detail.
